set: A: the page with the loader, the whole machine and the clear ball sheet beside the approved images, whole and in crops

issues.what: -a is a low, near-frontal view of one gently sloping playfield inside a wide, continuous satin-aluminium rim with rounded front corners. -b looks down from higher up at a stack of steep tiers walled by tall black risers, and its front corners open onto dark wood-grain side panels with gaps, so it reads as a different machine
issues.fix: lower the camera and bring it forward to -a's angle, make the tier steps shallow and low so the field reads as one slope, and close the cabinet with -a's wide satin-aluminium rim with rounded corners. Remove the exposed wood side panels

issues.where: the lower and middle playfield, light and colour
issues.what: -a's field is a glowing deep teal-navy enamel with dozens of hot warm lamps and pools of warm light. -b is darker, muddier and cooler, with far fewer lit inserts, and the strip of lamps along the inner right wall is missing
issues.fix: raise the warm general illumination and the brightness of the inserts, light the full lamp strip down the inside of the right wall, and bring the enamel back to a clean teal-navy with warm reflections

issues.where: the wire ramp across the centre
issues.what: -a has one low chrome wire rail curving across the lower-middle field. -b has a tall, oversized wireform ramp that climbs from the left slingshot to the upper right and cuts across the bumpers and middle tier
issues.fix: replace it with -a's low, thin chrome rail at playfield height, following -a's arc above the lower inserts

issues.what: -a's backbox is a large satin-aluminium frame with the title in thin, widely spaced cream capitals over the skyline. -b's marquee is a smaller, thinner strip set higher above a dark louvred box, its title is set in heavy outlined yellow letters, and the Corporate HQ stack rises into it
issues.fix: enlarge the backbox to -a's proportions in its satin frame, set the title in light, widely spaced cream capitals, remove the louvred box and keep the tower clear below the score panel

issues.where: the bumper crop (and the bumpers in set-A-03-b)
issues.what: -a's bumpers have glossy white domed caps over warm-lit brass bodies. -b's are open grey-rimmed cups with an orange-brown fill, like coffee cups
issues.fix: model a white domed cap over a brass skirt and a lit body, as in -a

issues.where: the garage crop (and set-A-03-b, right of centre)
issues.what: -a's garage is a compact solid spiral of stacked satin-metal rings. -b's is a tall open lattice cage with thin uprights
issues.fix: build it as solid concentric ramp rings with no cage, at -a's low height

issues.where: the tower crop and the sign-at-the-head crop
issues.what: the two crops are the same frame, so the tower has no crop of its own. The tower itself is a grey-framed stacked box with labels, not -a's glass cube with a single lit doorway
issues.fix: frame the tower crop on the tower, and make it a clear glass cube with a warm-lit door at its base

issues.where: the arrow and plunger crops (and set-A-03-b, lower right)
issues.what: in -a the ball sits in an open shooter lane above a visible chrome spring and an orange plunger knob, inside the aluminium rim. In -b the ball floats in a black-walled glass tube high on the right wall, the spring is missing, and the plunger is a black rod with an orange knob jutting out beside a dark wood panel
issues.fix: show the shooter lane with a chrome coil spring and the orange knob at the foot inside the rim. Keep the settled feed tube, but end it at the plunger without walling in the lane

issues.what: -a's crop centres on the cream Unemployment Office card between the flippers. -b's crop shows the score display and the HR plate instead
issues.fix: frame the crop on the centre card at the foot

issues.what: -a shows three tall panels side by side, split by black gutters, with one ball state in each. -b is a single unbroken frame holding three balls
issues.fix: split the sheet into three equal vertical panels with dark gutters, one state per panel, in -a's order

issues.what: -a's arrow is glossy white enamel with a thick, crisp black edge, and in the third state it is visibly melted and warped. -b's arrows are matte light grey with only a soft dark extrusion, and none of them is deformed
issues.fix: give the arrow a glossy white face and a bold black rim, and apply -a's melt and warp to the third state

issues.what: -a's surface is dark navy enamel with teal swirls and gold pinstripes, warm low-key light and a shallow depth of field. -b's is a green speckled, terrazzo-like grain under flat, even light, with everything in focus
issues.fix: keep the insert layout but change the surface to glossy navy-teal enamel with gold lines, darken it, warm the light, and blur the background and foreground

issues.where: the cursor ball and its bowl, right
issues.what: -a's ball is clear, thick glass with a crisp white arrow and a soft caustic on the floor of a satin bowl. In -b the arrow inside the ball is smeared and broken, and the ball reads as a grey ring in a bowl with dashed rings and screws
issues.fix: render the arrow sharp and whole behind clear glass with -a's refraction, and make the bowl one plain satin rim with a soft contact shadow

issues.what: -a's tube is thick clear glass with chrome collars, and it casts a soft shadow on the page. -b's tube is flat, with opaque vertical stripes inside it and almost no shadow
issues.fix: remove the inner stripes, add the thick-wall refraction and chrome collars, and cast a soft shadow to the lower right

issues.where: the tube along the rail and its bend
issues.what: -a has evenly spaced chrome collars with tight shadows. -b has fewer collars, grey bars inside the tube and dark blocks at the bend, and its shadow on the page is weak
issues.fix: space the chrome collars evenly, clear the inside of the tube and add a soft shadow below and to the right

issues.where: the left lock tube's front end
issues.what: -a's tube ends in a clear glass cup on a chrome foot. -b caps it with a heavy black disc
issues.fix: replace the cap with a clear glass end on a chrome base

issues.what: -a's yellow triangular chevron signs stand upright on chrome posts. -b's are black-and-yellow striped plates laid back over the slingshots
issues.fix: stand them up as yellow triangles with a dark chevron, on posts

issues.where: the red glass cylinder left of centre and the house cluster at Mom's Basement
issues.what: neither is in -a. -a has a single house at that spot and no red cylinder
issues.fix: remove the red cylinder and reduce the cluster to -a's single house

issues.where: the orange button and the page grain
issues.what: the button is a darker red-orange with less gloss, and the page is slightly greyer with a coarser stucco grain than -a's smooth cream
issues.fix: lighten the button to -a's bright glossy orange, and warm and smooth the page grain
